title: Wait, What?!
description: Facts so surprising they make you say 'Wait, what?!'

facts.fact: You can fit all the planets in the solar system between Earth and the Moon
facts.fact_ar: يمكنك وضع جميع كواكب النظام الشمسي بين الأرض والقمر
facts.detail: The average distance to the Moon is 384,400 km. Add up the diameters of all planets: Mercury, Venus, Mars, Jupiter, Saturn, Uranus, and Neptune = 380,016 km. They all fit!

facts.fact: There's a planet made entirely of diamonds
facts.fact_ar: هناك كوكب مصنوع بالكامل من الألماس
facts.detail: 55 Cancri e, located 40 light-years away, is twice the size of Earth and may be made largely of carbon in the form of diamonds and graphite.

facts.fact: Astronauts grow up to 2 inches taller in space
facts.fact_ar: رواد الفضاء يزداد طولهم حتى 5 سم في الفضاء
facts.detail: Without gravity compressing their spines, the vertebrae expand. They shrink back to normal size when they return to Earth.

facts.fact: A day on Mercury is twice as long as a year on Mercury
facts.fact_ar: يوم على عطارد أطول مرتين من سنة على عطارد
facts.detail: Mercury takes 59 Earth days to rotate once but only 88 days to orbit the Sun. One full day-night cycle on Mercury takes 176 Earth days.

facts.fact: There's a cloud of alcohol 6,500 light-years away big enough to fill 400 trillion trillion pints
facts.fact_ar: هناك سحابة كحول على بعد 6,500 سنة ضوئية كافية لملء 400 تريليون تريليون كوب
facts.detail: Sagittarius B2 is a giant molecular cloud containing ethyl alcohol. The cloud is 150 light-years across.

facts.fact: The footprints on the Moon will last for 100 million years
facts.fact_ar: آثار الأقدام على القمر ستبقى لـ 100 مليون سنة
facts.detail: There's no wind, rain, or water to erode them. Only micrometeorites slowly degrade the surface over millions of years.

facts.fact: Space smells like seared steak and gunpowder
facts.fact_ar: رائحة الفضاء مثل اللحم المشوي والبارود
facts.detail: Astronauts describe the smell that clings to their suits after spacewalks as metallic, like seared steak, gunpowder, or raspberries.

facts.fact: The largest known star could fit 5 billion of our Suns
facts.fact_ar: أكبر نجم معروف يمكن أن يتسع لـ 5 مليارات شمس
facts.detail: UY Scuti is so large that if placed in our solar system, its surface would extend past Jupiter's orbit.

facts.fact: Neutron stars spin up to 716 times per second
facts.fact_ar: النجوم النيوترونية تدور حتى 716 مرة في الثانية
facts.detail: PSR J1748-2446ad is the fastest known spinning pulsar. At its equator, it's moving at about 24% the speed of light.

facts.fact: There's a planet that rains glass sideways
facts.fact_ar: هناك كوكب تمطر فيه الزجاج بشكل جانبي
facts.detail: HD 189733b has winds of 5,400 mph that blow molten glass particles horizontally across the planet's surface.

facts.fact: You could survive in space without a suit for about 15 seconds
facts.fact_ar: يمكنك البقاء في الفضاء بدون بدلة لحوالي 15 ثانية
facts.detail: You wouldn't freeze or explode instantly. You'd remain conscious for about 15 seconds before losing consciousness from lack of oxygen.

facts.fact: Saturn would float if you could put it in water
facts.fact_ar: زحل سيطفو لو وضعته في الماء
facts.detail: Saturn's density is only 0.687 g/cm³, less than water (1 g/cm³). It's the only planet in our solar system less dense than water.

facts.fact: There are more trees on Earth than stars in the Milky Way
facts.fact_ar: هناك أشجار على الأرض أكثر من النجوم في درب التبانة
facts.detail: Earth has about 3 trillion trees. The Milky Way has an estimated 100-400 billion stars. Trees outnumber stars by about 10 to 1.

facts.fact: The coldest place in the known universe is on Earth
facts.fact_ar: أبرد مكان في الكون المعروف موجود على الأرض
facts.detail: Scientists have cooled atoms to within a billionth of a degree above absolute zero in laboratories, colder than any natural location in space.

facts.fact: Light from some stars you see tonight left before humans existed
facts.fact_ar: ضوء بعض النجوم التي تراها الليلة انطلق قبل وجود البشر
facts.detail: Stars like Deneb are about 2,500 light-years away. Their light left when Egyptian pyramids were being built.
